data: Explosive projectiles rain down upon creatures in a 10 foot radius, centered on a point within range. Any creature caught in the blast must make a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on a fail and half as much on a success. This move saps you of energy, and may not activate it again until after the end of your next turn.
Startles all other Pokémon. User cannot act in the next turn.
All Pokemon must make a CHA Saving Throw against your Intimidation/Persuasion DC.
